$comment: Extensible Dashboard V4 contract catalog. Add new $defs for later DTOs; do not rename or reshape existing definitions. Connection, template, destination, and credential listings are secret-free. OnboardingCommitRequest.secretInput, CredentialRotateRequest.secretInput, and IdentityCredentialCreateRequest.secretInput are write-only. Operation and request log reads redact known stored secrets.

Account.description:
Secret-free account resource. Distinct from `models::Account`.

Responses emit `T | null` for every optional field. Plaintext upstream
keys, passwords, ciphers, gateway Keys, and referral codes never appear.

AccountAuthScheme.description: Custom auth scheme. Wire values match V2 kebab-case.

AccountConfigurationOwnerDto.description: Owner of endpoint, protocol and model configuration.

AccountControlsDto.description: Read-only account actions derived from the destination's resource ownership.

AccountCustomConfig.description: Nested Custom HTTP destination as returned on an account.

AccountModelCapability.description: One declared Custom model capability as returned on an account.

AccountPageRefreshRequest.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

AccountSetupStep.description: Managed-setup wizard step. Wire values match V2 snake_case.

AccountToggleWriteDto.description: Persistence target for the account enable switch.

AccountUpstreamProtocol.description: Custom/upstream protocol. Wire values match V2 snake_case.

AccountVerificationStatus.description: Connection-verification status. Wire values match V2 snake_case.

AdapterKindDto.description: Sealed adapter kind. Wire values match the domain serde names.

AliasPublication.description:
Public names currently hidden from authenticated `GET /v1/models`.

Missing names default to published. Hidden names remain routable.

AliasPublicationUpdate.description:
Toggle one public name's downstream listing. `publicModel` is

AuthSchemeDto.description: Destination auth scheme. Wire values match the domain serde names.

AuthorizationState.description: Local authorization projection. Unknown is not a verified success.

BillingSnapshotRequest.description: Bounded, local-only batch read; it is not a control-plane mutation.

billingTierRequired.description: A billing tier must be selected before the destination is usable.

discoverableModels.description: The destination can discover models from the upstream.

externalIntegration.description: The destination is an external integration and holds no local inference secret.

identityHeaders.description: The adapter attaches identity headers on egress.

managedSignup.description: Managed signup can start an onboarding task on a credential.

observer.description: The destination holds a non-inference observer credential (platform parent).

officialBalanceProbe.description: Hosts Configurable HTTP may probe for an official current-balance API.

testable.description: Test connection is offered on every ready credential except external integrations.

CapabilitySummary.description: Registry pricing or usage availability copied as display data.

CardCapabilitySummary.description: Provider-page actions that are actually implemented for this scope.

CatalogModelDto.description: One catalog model on a destination.

upstreamModel.description: Upstream model id sent on egress.

CatalogModelEditRequest.description:
A built-in model mapping edit. The original upstream identity is immutable
for selection, while the replacement may change its public and upstream IDs.

CatalogModelsAddRequest.description: Add disabled model IDs to a local built-in Provider catalog. No outbound I/O.

CatalogModelsRemoveRequest.description:
Remove models from a persisted built-in Provider catalog snapshot.

Local-only. An official catalog refresh may add the same IDs back.

officialBalance.description: Official balance support for this exact configured URL, including its path.

ConnectionLifecycle.description:
V4 connection lifecycle, including persisted onboarding drafts.

Draft is control-plane only: routing snapshots never carry it.

creditPresets.description:
Personal credit setup for Key forms. None means unsupported; an empty
list permits custom configuration without a provider preset.

ContractEvidenceSource.description: How a protocol row was established. Wire values match V2 snake_case.

ContractScopeKind.description: Contract scope kind. Wire values match V2 `provider` / `custom_endpoint`.

ControlRevision.description: Live CAS token, process generation, and pricing snapshot id.

CopilotTokenBudget.description: Local Copilot request budgets, not declarations about upstream capability.

DestinationCredentialDto.description: RFC credential projection row. Carries `hasSecret` only; never ciphertext or plaintext.

hasSecret.description: Whether a secret is stored. Always false for keyless Zen and CPA.

id.description: Stable credential id (deterministic UUIDv5 of the legacy account).

lastError.description: Last error string from the legacy account row, or null.

legacyAccountId.description:
The V3 `accounts` row this credential was projected from (migration-era

purchaseDate.description: Purchase date when the destination has a Plan.

quotaPoolId.description: Shared quota pool id when the credential joined one.

quotaRecovery.description: Confirmed per-Key exhaustion/recovery. Omitted or null means no confirmed exhaustion.

routingRank.description: Position in the persisted account order.

DestinationDto.description: Secret-free destination facts and derived account controls.

baseUrl.description: Upstream origin. Sealed for builtin adapters; user data for `http`.

brandFamily.description: Brand family for grouping, when the adapter or platform kind has one.

id.description: Stable destination id (deterministic UUIDv5 of the legacy row).

legacy.description: V3 row this destination was projected from.

maxCredentials.description: `1` for true singletons; `null` for multi-credential destinations.

modelResolution.description: Model-name resolution owned by this destination.

observerCredentialId.description: Non-inference observer credential id when `capabilities.observer` is set.

DestinationList.description: RFC destination list. Revision-tagged and secret-free.

authorizeCredentialIds.description:
Explicit consent to add safe grants for the destination's current

credentials.description:
Complete secret-free credential projection after the mutation. A
destination edit can reset verification, auth/cooldowns, and grants on
more than one Key, so returning only the destination row is stale by
construction.

DestinationProjectionRefusedError.description: 409 envelope when `destination_projection` refuses. Same V3 fields plus `details`.

DestinationUpstreamOverridePatch.description: Optional per-model route override for a configurable HTTP destination.

EffectiveCatalog.description: Merged model-id catalog for one contract scope.

EffectiveModelContract.description: One model's preferred protocol and per-protocol evidence.

EffectiveModelProtocols.description:
Per-protocol evidence keyed by snake_case protocol tokens. Missing
protocols serialize as `null` and must not be invented as available.

EffectiveProtocolEvidence.description: Merged evidence for one upstream protocol on one model.

EligibilityReason.description: Why a connection is eligible or not. `None` is a successful Eligible row.

EligibilityState.description: Local attempt eligibility. Unknown authorization may still be Eligible.

EndpointAuthScheme.description:
Auth advertised on a connection endpoint. `Sealed` is used for built-in
adapters whose scheme is owned by code, not by the projected row.

EndpointOperation.description:
Inference operation advertised by one endpoint. Mapped 1:1 from
[`UpstreamProtocolKind`].

ExpiryCadenceDto.description: How a Plan expires, when it has a cadence.

ForwardLog.description:
One redacted forward-log row plus native model identity. There is no
`requestedAlias` field.

LegacyConnectionKind.description: Pre-unification row a connection was projected from.

LegacyDestinationKindDto.description: Which V3-era row a destination was projected from.

oneOf.description: Account-owned Custom API endpoint; `id` is the account id.
New API / Sub2API site; `id` is the platform parent id.

LegacyDestinationRefDto.description:
Migration-era bridge from a projected destination back to the V3 row that
still owns its mutations. Removed once destinations become primary.

id.description: Row id in the V3 model named by `kind`.

reasoningEfforts.description:
Exact DSH selector level -> Chat Completions reasoning_effort spelling.
Absence is unknown, an empty map explicitly offers no selectable levels.

ModelMetadataCatalog.description:
Every destination's effective metadata in one payload. The alias page
renders per-mapping capabilities from this single read; fanning the
per-destination endpoint out across rows would serialize N full routing
snapshots behind the settings lock.

ModelResolutionDto.description: Which client model names may resolve to a destination mapping.

nextResetAt.description: First renewal boundary and immutable calendar anchor, including its UTC time.

timezoneOffsetMinutes.description: Calendar boundaries use this fixed UTC offset, e.g. 480 for China.

OllamaBillingTier.description:
Paid Ollama Cloud billing profile. Wire values are exactly `pro`, `max`,
and `team`. Absence of a stored row (migrated/unconfigured) and non-Ollama
accounts serialize the account field as `null`.

OnboardingCommitRequest.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

authorizeCurrentEndpoint.description:
Explicit consent to union safe current default/same-origin grants.
Ignored unless `mode` is present; false is omitted from the digest.

mode.description: Omitted preserves legacy commit behavior and HMAC digest bytes.

accountId.description: Legacy receipts omit this; replay emits null via serde default.

configuration.description: Required when `mode` is present. Legacy mode-None existing rejects this.

OperationLog.description: One user-operation receipt. `completed_at` is null only while `pending`.

OperationMetadata.description: Allowlisted, non-secret facts about one user operation.

PlanDto.description: Commercial offering embedded in a destination. Mirrors the domain `Plan`.

manualCalibration.description: Operators may enter local usage numbers by hand.

PlatformKeyImportRequest.description: Import New API inference tokens as local Custom Keys. Secret-free.

page.description: One bounded remote page; omission starts at page one.

nextPage.description: More remote rows exist, even if every row in this batch was skipped.

source.description: A storefront row is never proof of inference permission.

input.description: All numeric rates are currency per token, never per million tokens.

errors.description: Fixed component/error codes only, never upstream bodies or credentials.

PricingSourceDto.description: Where a Plan's prices come from.

ProbeResultKind.description:
Last explicit probe outcome stored on evidence. Distinct from
[`ProtocolProbeResult`].

ProtocolDto.description: Wire protocol for destination catalog and transport rows.

ProtocolOverrideState.description: Per-model/per-protocol override state. `auto` removes any persisted override.

ProviderAccountChoice.description: Secret-free account identity on a contract card.

ProviderCatalogEntry.description:
One Provider Registry entry as a wire catalog row. Identity strings are
data copied from the static registry; this DTO does not define them.

deletable.description: Whether the dashboard may DELETE this entry. Same rules as `editable`.

editable.description:
Whether the dashboard may PATCH this entry. Always `false` for
`builtin` rows; `true` for `preset`/`custom`.

offering.description:
Plan/api offering label carried by the catalog row. Builtin rows use
the sealed builtin map; dynamic rows mirror the persisted `offering`.

origin.description:
Row provenance in the unified `providers` table. Wire values:
`builtin` (sealed adapter), `preset` (preset-derived dynamic row),
`custom` (manual dynamic row).

deletable.description: Whether the dashboard may DELETE this entry. Same rules as `editable`.

editable.description:
Whether the dashboard may PATCH this entry. Always `false` for
`builtin` rows; `true` for `preset`/`custom`.

offering.description:
Plan/api offering label carried by the catalog row. Builtin rows use
the sealed builtin map; dynamic rows mirror the persisted `offering`.

origin.description:
Row provenance in the unified `providers` table. Wire values:
`builtin` (sealed adapter), `preset` (preset-derived dynamic row),
`custom` (manual dynamic row).

ProviderCatalogFormField.description: One create-form field advertised by a catalog provider.

ProviderCatalogPresentation.description: Canonical catalog facts committed directly from a mutation receipt.

revision.description: Display revision for this scope, distinct from the top-level CAS token.

staticProtocolSnapshotDate.description:
The built-in provider's static protocol-evidence snapshot date. This is
`null` when the scope has no restorable snapshot and is distinct from
catalog `refreshed_at`.

ProviderContracts.description:
Effective provider-scope and custom-endpoint contracts.

Top-level `revision` is the settings CAS token. Nested `revision` values
are display-only and must not be sent as `expectedRevision`.

ProviderDefinition.description:
Secret-free Provider definition. Surfaces both builtin and dynamic rows
through the same wire shape. `endpointUrl` / `upstreamProtocol` /
`authKind` are nullable because builtin rows leave them empty (the sealed
adapter drives those at call time).

authKind.description: Nullable: builtin rows leave the field empty.

deletable.description: Whether the dashboard may DELETE this row. Always `false` for builtin.

editable.description: Whether the dashboard may PATCH this row. Always `false` for builtin.

endpointUrl.description: Nullable: builtin rows leave the field empty.

models.description: Empty for builtin rows; builtin catalogs feed the contract projection.

offering.description: Plan/api offering label persisted alongside the row.

upstreamProtocol.description: Nullable: builtin rows leave the field empty.

ProviderDefinitionAuthKind.description:
Auth kind owned by a Provider definition. Independent of protocol.
Nullable on the wire because builtin rows leave the field empty.

ProviderModelUpstreamOverride.description: One public-to-upstream mapping owned by a Provider definition.

ProviderOrigin.description:
Provenance of a row in the unified `providers` table. The column is
additive in v42 and never feeds routing decisions: builtin adapters stay
sealed, and dynamic rows keep their `ConfigurableHttp` adapter path.

ProviderUsage.description:
GET `/accounts/{id}/provider-usage` body. Distinct from stored quota rows.

`pricingRevision` is always absent. Usage is no longer a pricing CAS token.

QuotaRecoveryDto.description: Optional per-Key quota recovery overlay. Status is presentation-only.

QuotaRecoveryReason.description: Why the credential was confirmed exhausted.

QuotaRecoveryStatus.description: Presentation status for a confirmed quota-recovery episode.

QuotaRecoveryWindow.description: Window named by confirmed exhaustion evidence.

QuotaWindow.description: One live or synthetic quota window. Distinct from `models::QuotaWindow`.

RedirectPolicyDto.description: Redirect policy advertised on a destination.

RefusedRowDto.description: Identity of one legacy row the stage-4a projection refused.

providerId.description: Provider id when the refused row is an account.

RefusedRowKindDto.description: Legacy row kind named in a destination-projection refusal.

RequestAttempts.description: Attempt detail reuses the V3 forward-log DTO.

RequestLog.description: One logical request projected from `forward_logs` attempts.

attemptCount.description: Upstream attempts. A pre-upstream `attempt = 0` row contributes zero.

durationMs.description: Newest attempt's cumulative elapsed, only when that attempt recorded one.

recordedRowCount.description: Stored `forward_logs` rows in this logical request, including attempt 0.

RoutingCardList.description: One consistent, secret-free snapshot of cards and the resources they show.

RoutingCardUpdate.description: The flattened card and row sequence is the complete routing priority order.

RoutingConversationBinding.description:
Conversation stickiness is reported, not applied: this endpoint has no
conversation input.

RoutingExplanation.description:
Read-only routing prediction for `GET /routing/explain`.

This is not a send guarantee. `runtimeOnlyUncertainty` names the live
steps this snapshot does not execute.

RoutingMode.description: Account selection mode. Wire values stay kebab-case, matching V2.

RoutingResolvedKind.description: How the requested name resolved against the live alias registry.

UsageAvailability.description: Registry usage availability. Wire values stay snake_case.

UsageSourceDto.description: Where a Plan reads usage from.

UsageSyncState.description:
Official-usage sync metadata as projected for provider usage. Distinct from
the stored `provider_usage_sync_state` row.

V3Error.description: Stable non-2xx JSON envelope for every Dashboard V3 error.
